description: Reconstruct full session context in a single call — the recommended way to resume work. Returns narrative summary, key decisions, open threads, and last state.

exclude_topics.description: Filter out irrelevant threads during reconstruction

focus.description: Specific entity or topic to prioritize in reconstruction

from_memory_id.description: Resume from a specific point in the session (memory ID)

intent.description: What you need the context for — affects which details are preserved (default: continue_coding)

session_id.description: Session ID to resume (optional — uses most recent if omitted)

name: velixar_session_resume
